description_for_human: Provides row-level and aggregated (cube-style) access to the purchase register for an AI agent. Use get_purchase_register when the user wants to see individual invoices/transactions with optional sorting and pagination. Use get_purchase_aggregator when the user wants totals, breakdowns, trends, or a summary grouped by one to four dimensions (e.g. "monthly totals", "breakdown by supplier", "MSME vs non-MSME spend"), with optional sorting and pagination of the breakdown.
description_for_model: Provides row-level and aggregated (cube-style) access to the purchase register for an AI agent. Use get_purchase_register when the user wants to see individual invoices/transactions with optional sorting and pagination. Use get_purchase_aggregator when the user wants totals, breakdowns, trends, or a summary grouped by one to four dimensions (e.g. "monthly totals", "breakdown by supplier", "MSME vs non-MSME spend"), with optional sorting and pagination of the breakdown.

functions.name: getPurchaseAggregator
functions.description: Groups the purchase register by one to four dimensions and returns a totals summary plus a per-group breakdown with all measures (invoice_count, taxable_value, cgst_amount, sgst_amount, igst_amount, cess_amount, invoice_value, overdue_count). Use this whenever the user wants totals, trends, a breakdown, or a summary rather than raw invoice rows. group_by must be sent as a JSON array (1 to 4 dimensions) in the request body. Supports optional sort_by/sort_order and page/page_size for large breakdowns; omit page/page_size to return all groups.

functions.name: getPurchaseRegister
functions.description: Returns a paginated list of purchase register records, optionally filtered by document number, supplier, date ranges, MSME status, or payment status, with optional sorting (sort_by, sort_order) and pagination. Use this when the user wants to see specific invoices/transactions rather than totals or a breakdown.
